comments.author: anon-31e9bd66
comments.content: Added 26 new tests covering all v0.2.0 features. All 90 tests pass (64 existing + 26 new). Tests cover: new config settings, core.symlinks -y skip, safe.directory wildcard, pre-commit hook (audit + no-overwrite), global gitignore (create + skip + pattern audit), credential hygiene (all 4 file types + no false positives), SSH key hygiene (ed25519 OK, RSA warn, IdentityFile parsing), version bump.
